description:
Compute the WCAG contrast ratio between two hex colors and report AA/AAA pass/fail for normal and large text.

Returns: JSON { ratio, AA, AAA, AALarge, AAALarge } for the two colors.
Example input: {"foreground":"#ffffff","background":"#3b82f6"}
On error, includes hint: Both colors must be hex (#rgb or #rrggbb).
name: contrast_check
title: WCAG contrast check
